title: Docs hotlist / SDK fixes — scratchpad
content:
Morning scratchpad — iterate quicklist of items I need to either push to PR or triage with Maya/Alex. Trying to keep this brief so I actually ship things. Rough priorities: 1) tutorial friction, 2) sample apps, 3) quick doc errata for hosted API, 4) small SDK surface fixes that break onboarding flows.

Top-of-mind TODOs (quick):
- [ ] Docs: Fix step ordering in "First API Call" tutorial (users hit 401 because we document the wrong header order). Minimal fix: swap example to show Authorization before other headers, call out token scopes. (JIRA: DOCS-1423)
- [ ] SDK: Type hints for Python client-> generate() return type currently Any, hurts mypy/VSCode. Small patch: add TypedDict for Response and update stubs. (SDK PR: #456)
- [ ] Sample app: Chat demo keeps truncating long contexts — need to add note about kv-cache param and recommend paginated messages example. Create new snippet in sample-apps/chat/ that demonstrates incremental cache reuse.
- [ ] Tutorial: Add troubleshooting section for common rate-limit responses + recommended retry/backoff policy. Link to SRE runbook.
- [ ] Quick blog blurb: quantization effects on latency — gather 3 datapoints from benchmark harness and draft 200–300 word note for product newsletter.

Notes for each item:
1) "First API Call" ordering issue
- Repro steps I used: fresh account, copy snippet from docs, paste into terminal. Observed 401. Finding: example shows header list where a custom x-client-meta header appears before Authorization; some HTTP libraries reorder/strip headers leading to missing Authorization in our cURL example.
- Fix options: a) reorder doc snippet to show Authorization first; b) call out explicit curl example with -H 'Authorization: Bearer ...' and place other headers after.
- Acceptance: someone new following tutorial gets a 200 on first run (manual check). Add unit test that validates example in docs -> run in CI? Maybe overkill but worth a smoke test.

2) Python SDK typing
- Current state: generate() returns dict, but there are users relying on typed response (autocomplete). Patch: add ResponseTyped = TypedDict('ResponseTyped', {'id': str, 'object': str, 'choices': List[Dict[str, Any]], 'usage': Dict[str, int]}) and annotate return.
- Risk: typing mismatch if we change server response shape. Keep versioned types per SDK release (v0.8 types = ...). Add comment in stubs.
- Quick tests: run mypy in CI + add one doctest in README showing type usage.

3) Sample chat app kv-cache note
- Problem: sample chat stores messages in a list and sends full history each time. For longer contexts this adds latency and token cost.
- Proposed snippet to insert: show how to persist kv-cache between requests in Node and Python pseudo-code. Include note: "Only compatible with models that expose forward cache API" and link to runtime docs.
- Add small benchmark: same conversation replayed with/without cache for 10 rounds. Capture mean latency and token usage.

4) Retry guidance (rate limit)
- Add brief policy text: exponential backoff starting at 250ms, jitter, max 8 retries; fallback to lower-tier model or queued async webhook call. Map to Console features: show how to configure route fallback in rollouts UI.

Quick snippets I want in docs (raw):
- cURL working example (short):
  curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate 
    -H 'Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY' 
    -H 'Content-Type: application/json' 
    -d '{"model":"redwood-1.0","input":"Say hi"}'

- Node snippet for persistent kv-cache (pseudo):
  const cache = new KVCache();
  async function chatRound(input) {
    const resp = await client.generate({model: 'redwood-chat', input, kv_cache: cache});
    return resp.output;
  }

Outstanding questions / decisions to bring up with Maya/Alex:
- Do we enforce typed response in the SDK now or wait until after the next API schema freeze? (tradeoff: helpful for DX vs churn for downstream users)
- For the tutorial fix, do we run a quick CI smoke test that executes the examples? Costs some CI time but would reduce future regressions.
- Where to put the kv-cache sample: add as a file in sample-apps/chat or extend the tutorials section? I slightly prefer sample-apps so it can be cloned and run.

Meeting notes snippet for sync with Maya (15m):
- Quick agenda: prioritize 2 small PRs (doc ordering + python typing), assign reviewers, agree on small benchmark to include in PR.
- Outcome options: if doc fix is trivial, ship today and patch live; if typing patch requires API schema change, schedule for next minor release.

Small checklist for today's push:
- [ ] Open PR for docs header reorder (label: docs, priority: high)
- [ ] Add typed stub + mypy run in SDK repo (label: sdk, priority: med)
- [ ] Create chat sample branch and add cache example (label: sample-apps, priority: low-medium)
- [ ] Draft retry guidance blurb and link to SRE runbook (label: docs, priority: med)

Notes-to-self: do not overdocument tiny implementation details — keep tutorials opinionated and short. Focus on first-run success. If in doubt, add a "Troubleshooting" fold at the end rather than bloating the main flow.

Random fragment ideas to stash (maybe later):
- Mini playground: "Try quantized vs fp16" slider in sample-apps to show latency delta live (maybe too product-ey).
- Quick checklist for private deployments: necessary env var names, minimum GPU memory, kv-cache compatibility note.

End of scratch for now — will tidy and create PRs. If I don't push by EOD, ping me in #devx-reminders.

Timestamp: 2026-03-13 09:12 PT
